# Cold Email Frameworks — Broken Fixture v1

This fixture deliberately breaks the rules. verify_doc.py must FAIL it and name each break.

# FRAMEWORK 1: "Everything Wrong"

**Subject line options:** `Quick Question About Your Revenue Growth Plans` | `free audit`

**Example (test, Nowhere):**

> Hey Sam,
>
> I hope this finds you well! I wanted to reach out because our innovative solution leverages AI and automation to transform your business — and it's guaranteed. As I mentioned, we can unlock 10x ROI for a tiny price, totally free. Check it out at https://example.com and book a quick call.
>
> {sender}

**Follow-up (reply in thread, 3 days later):**

> Just following up on my last note. Here are two links: https://a.com and https://b.com. Let me know.

**Spin set:**
    subject: {{RANDOM | free stuff | act now!}}

# THE TWO CLOSERS

**Closer 1 (new thread):**

> Hey Sam, I've sent a lot of notes about our amazing program and I really want to know whether a fifteen minute call might make sense for you this quarter, because if it doesn't I would like to stop writing to you, and I also want to be respectful of your time and your inbox.

**Closer 2 (reply in thread):**

> Free free free.
